result.summary: This PR extracts 17 self-contained helper functions out of PeerManagerImpl::SendMessages(), a roughly 500-line function handling per-message-type sends in net_processing.cpp, reducing the main function to under 90 lines. Each commit is a pure code move with added declarations, thread-safety annotations, and one-line call sites, with no behavioral change intended. It follows the pattern of prior similar refactor PRs (#35502, #35148, #34059) and a previous 2017 attempt (#9579).
result.problem: SendMessages() has grown into a large monolithic function that is hard to navigate and review, which the author encountered while reviewing #34824. Reviewers and future contributors working in this hot area of net_processing.cpp bear the cost of this complexity.

categories.evidence: The PR entirely rewrites the structure of PeerManagerImpl::SendMessages() in src/net_processing.cpp, the core p2p per-peer message-sending loop, matching the p2p category's path prior.
categories.rationale: P3 because this is a stated move-only refactor with no behavioral change, addressing pure code readability rather than a correctness, performance, or user-facing problem. The author's own framing is that it makes an oversized function 'hard to navigate and review,' which the category treats as an internal concern unless it retires a hazard; here it does not, it only reorganizes code. Its main leverage is easing review of related in-flight PRs (#34824, #35502) that follow the same pattern, but it also currently conflicts with 7 other open p2p PRs in the same file, showing this is a contested, high-churn area rather than a blocking dependency.

uncertainties: Whether this PR is a hard prerequisite for #34824 or #35502 landing, or merely a stylistic companion, is not explicitly stated as a dependency by either PR.

No functional testing changes accompany this move-only refactor; confidence that it is truly behavior-preserving rests on the author's commit messages and reviewer trust rather than independent verification.
result.card: This PR is a pure move-only refactor that extracts 17 named helper functions out of the ~500-line PeerManagerImpl::SendMessages() in net_processing.cpp, cutting the main function to under 90 lines, with no intended behavior change. It addresses a code-navigability problem the author hit while reviewing #34824, and follows the same pattern as #35502, #35148, and #34059. Two reviewers gave concept/approach ACKs with no objections, and the one docstring nit raised was fixed in a later push. The PR currently needs a rebase (Needs rebase label, mergeable_state unknown) and the author has been silent for 35 days, and it conflicts with 7 other open p2p PRs touching the same function, signalling contention in this area. As a non-behavioral refactor it ranks as worthwhile but not category-critical in p2p.
